text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The Queen Elizabeth II Cup has finally concluded!
This year's queen has been decided!!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...It's over.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, please give another round of applause
to honor this year's queen!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"The Queen Elizabeth II Cup,
the stage I always dreamed of—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Woooooaaaaahhh!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —It ended before I could even win.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I worked hard.
I worked really, really hard.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yet I still couldn't reach it...!
On the dream stage I finally managed to reach...!
choice_data_list: Let's do our best next year, too.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list: As long as you keep fighting, you will surely win.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, yes... hk. Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A true princess never gives up.
Not until the day I become my ideal princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Next time on this stage, I will claim victory...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, per Kawakami Princess's request,
we spent the time before the concert watching
the racecourse from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...To think that just a moment ago,
I was running on this very track."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What are you spacing out for?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Ms. Sweep.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm tellin' you right now.
Next year, I'm runnin' in both the Victoria Mile
and the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Come along if you want.
Even after the Classic Year ends,
the battle continues in the Senior Year.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I'd like to decide on our next goal.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
So that I can return to this race again.
To become a princess.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Once winter passes, it'll immediately be the Senior Class.
To support her growth, we should set a goal before the spring GⅠ season as well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's a medium-distance turf GII. Since it's held in March, it should allow us to adapt no matter which GI race she wishes to run in during the spring GI season.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, understood!!
Once we get back to the academy, the training plan—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Kawakami Princess froze in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Um... Ah. No...

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! There you are!
I wanted to talk about the concert rehearsal...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, neither during the live rehearsal nor after the performance was I able to find out why she had frozen in place.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after returning to the trainer's office,
Kawakami Princess was still—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list: Shall we continue the meeting tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
N-No! Today is better!
Today would be—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Because that way, I won't have to overthink things.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Displayed on the smartphone screen was the name of the TV producer who had helped us out before the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A phone call for you, Trainer-san!
Don't worry, I'll wait right here.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!! Go right ahead!
The meeting can wait until after!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle...)

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? If it isn't that princess.
Could she be friends with Sweep Tosho too?

text_block_list.name: Madam Wearing a Hat
text_block_list.text:
I see. That makes sense then.
Even regarding what happened at the Oaks and Shuka Sho.
...What a truly selfish girl.

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she's not princess-like at all, despite her name...
I'm glad she didn't become a queen.

text_block_list.name: Madam Wearing a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, even fate must have forsaken her.
Deciding that girl isn't worthy to be queen.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—I am unfit to be queen...
That is why... destiny has forsaken me.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...No, no, Princess!
Getting depressed isn't like a princess at all! Isn't... like...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Geez! ...Hmph! Take that!
Haa! Yah!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Deeeeeeeeeyah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(CRASH-BASH-CLATTER!!
FLAP-FLAP-FLAP-FLAP!!)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Nowah!? Eep, the cardboard box!?
The documents are falling!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"A-Ah-wa-wa... I have to put it back
before Trainer gets back—"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? Is this...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, Trainer!
My, what has gotten you in such a fluster?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Geez, nothing escapes this princess's eyes!
Though I'll pretend I didn't see anything for now♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, to think you'd prepare a surprise gift
for when I win the Queen Elizabeth II Cup♪
As expected of my Trainer, how stylish of you♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That surprise present...
you had with you before, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (Glances around)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, excuse me.
Please let me borrow some energy in advance."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
When I receive it later,
I'll act like I didn't know and be happy, I promise...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...Letters? Addressed to me and Trainer...?
There are so many... even more than the fan mail
I usually get..."
